description: This file contains declarations for functions related to ONNX shape and type inference within the PyTorch JIT compiler, including merging types, setting dynamic input shapes, assigning output shapes, and shape inference for nodes and graphs.

methods.name: MergeInferredType
methods.description: Merges existing and inferred types, prioritizing inferred type for compatibility with ONNX.

methods.name: MergeInferredTypeAndSetMap
methods.description: Merges types and updates the map for a given Value.

methods.name: ONNXSetDynamicInputShape
methods.description: Sets dynamic axes for graph inputs based on provided dynamic axes map.

methods.name: ONNXAssignOutputShape
methods.description: Assigns output tensor types in the graph, merging with inferred types if shape inference is enabled.

methods.name: ReplaceGraphOutputNoneWithOptional
methods.description: Replaces None outputs in the graph with Optional nodes for script models.

methods.name: ONNXOptionalNodeForNone
methods.description: Creates an Optional node for None output in the graph.

methods.name: ONNXShapeTypeInference
methods.description: Performs shape and type inference on a node or graph using ONNX shape inference.

methods.name: AllGraphInputsStatic
methods.description: Checks if all graph inputs are static.

methods.name: AreInputsReliableOrStatic
methods.description: Determines if node inputs are reliable or static.

methods.name: UpdateReliable
methods.description: Updates reliability status of a Value or Node.

methods.name: UpdateShapeConstantIfReliable
methods.description: Updates shape constants if the output reliability is confirmed.
